notes: Phanpy Mastodon client home timeline. Each post is a 638px white card with 32px corner radius on #f0f2f5; consecutive cards separated by ~14px gaps. Boosted posts carry a faint purple-to-white diagonal gradient wash at the top-left with a rocket icon + mini avatar + 'X boosted'. Tiny colored status glyphs (heart = liked, rocket = boosted, bookmark = saved) sit at the card's top-right corner instead of a visible action bar; actions (Reply, Boost 3, Like 42, Save) appear only in a panel opened from the '…' next to the timestamp. Self-threads are grouped: first post, middle posts collapsed to one-line rows with '2/X' '3/X' pills, last post labelled 'THREAD 4/X', with a thin vertical connector line; replies-in-context show the parent as a faded excerpt above. Hashtags rendered with a muted '#' and dotted underline. Images have alt-text captions printed below; multi-image posts use a 2x2 grid with ALT¹ chips. Filtered posts collapse to a single row with a dashed 'FILTERED' tag. Polls (percent bars, 'Ending in 1 hour', Refresh) and a content-warning 'Show content' button exist in the AX tree further down (beyond the rendered capture). Floating circular blue/periwinkle compose FAB at bottom-right with soft shadow. Gradient-filled initials avatars. Lower part of the capture shows lazily-unrendered blank cards. Feed ends with 'The end.'
